s: The hybrid parameter-adaptive RAG system combines BM25, vector retrieval, reciprocal rank fusion, and a knowledge graph retriever to improve retrieval accuracy and response relevance. It can optionally use query rewriting and reranking before processing selected chunks and knowledge graph triplets within an LLM context window. The system has two variations: Parameter-Adaptive RAG without knowledge graph retrieval and Hybrid Parameter-Adaptive RAG with it. The AI Legal and Policy Corpus uses Local Law 144 (LL144) of 2021, enacted by the New York City Department of Consumer and Worker Protection, as a challenging corpus for evaluating AI compliance retrieval and interpretation.
